Evaluate the line integral ${\int }_{C}F(r)\cdot \text{d}r,$ where $F(x,y)=(x+y)\,i+(1-x)\,j$ and $C$ is the arc of the ellipse $9{x}^{2}+4{y}^{2}=36$  traversed from the point $A(0,3)$ to the point $B(-2,0).$
